events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Painted Demons

options.text: No, such titles will distract from their training.

events.text: Your reputation as a terrifying ruler has been enthusiastically embraced by some of your troops. One unit of [unit] in particular have taken to adorning their armor and faces with crude paintings of horrific demons and beasts to strike fear into the enemy. The infamous unit have asked for your blessing to be known as the Painted Demons to bring terror in your name.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Silver Shields

options.text: No, such titles will distract from their training.

events.text: The [unit] under [character] have been gaining a reputation within the army of being determined defenders, difficult to command but too stubborn to retreat. They have been nicknamed the Silver Shields as the many blows they take have worn the paint off their shields to show the silver metal below. Shall this name be made official to honor the unit?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Warriors of God

options.text: Go forth in the name of God!
No, such titles will distract from their training.

events.text: One of your units of [unit] have been zealously embracing the [religion] faith, only accepting believers and charging in without fear under the gaze of the that accompany the soldiers. They have asked to be granted the title of the Warriors of God to show their dedication and to stand as a beacon of faith to the rest of the army. Shall we reward their belief?
